expectedLearning: Whether one chrome-free canonical reader session can be mounted in Article v1 and windowed by named ranges without rebuilding, rescaling, or weakening canonical behavior.
allowedWork: Canonical fraction reader host extraction, Article v1 mounting, named-range windowing, parity tests, accessibility, lifecycle, and recovery documentation named by the approved proposal.
disallowedWork: New animation semantics, a replacement renderer, iframe embedding, a second clock, unrelated economics or Lisp work, article grammar changes, editor expansion, or catalog-wide rollout before the exemplar checkpoint.
